$Comment: A dungeon skill lock, the glowing bloom (Harvesting's): the game's azure fern (Plant_Flower_Orchid_Cyan's model, texture, mana particles and glow), made solid so a bank of blooms closes a nook. Using it does nothing on its own, so the use reaches the room's trigger volume, whose ZigRequires opens it for a player with the skill and whose RejectionEffects tell anyone else what opens it (the SkillLock room template, tools/rooms). It has no Gathering, so no survival player, creature or explosion can break or pick it and it drops nothing; it has no recipe and no category and is a Variant, so the creative library hides it. It needs no soil under it.
